seed.title: Replication claim assessment
seed.objective: Assess whether a reported intervention effect survives data audit, model competition, and adversarial replication.

tasks.title: Operationalize the claim
tasks.generatedPrompt: Translate the headline claim into measurable estimands, populations, interventions, comparators, and falsifiers.
claims: The target claim is operationally testable

tasks.title: Audit provenance and exclusions
tasks.generatedPrompt: Reconstruct data provenance, exclusion decisions, missingness, and leakage checks from immutable artifacts.

tasks.title: Compare structural explanations
tasks.generatedPrompt: Compare the intervention, confounding, and measurement-bias models on predeclared predictions and falsifiers.
claims: Alternatives are compared on discriminating evidence

tasks.title: Run adversarial replication gate
tasks.generatedPrompt: Execute the preregistered replication, report all deviations, and gate the claim on reproduced effect and sensitivity bounds.
claims: The conclusion is supported by independent current evidence

workspace.content: Prioritize observations that discriminate among active structural models.
workspace.removalCondition: All active models have been discriminated or explicitly retained as unresolved.

models.name: Causal intervention effect
models.prediction: Effect reproduces with stable direction and bounded heterogeneity.
models.falsifier: Independent replication confidence interval excludes the minimally relevant effect.

models.name: Residual confounding
models.prediction: Effect attenuates under negative controls or sensitivity adjustment.
models.falsifier: Negative controls are null and sensitivity bounds remain beyond plausible confounding.

models.name: Measurement artifact
models.prediction: Blinded independent scoring removes the observed effect.
models.falsifier: The effect persists with blinded validated measurement.

edit.replacement: Reconstruct data provenance, preregistered and post-hoc exclusions, missingness, temporal leakage, and analyst degrees of freedom from immutable artifacts.
edit.reason: The replication lead separated preregistered from post-hoc exclusions.
